title: A History of Assam (First Edition, 1906)
author: Sir Edward Albert Gait, K.C.S.I., C.I.E.
provenance: Calcutta: Thacker, Spink & Co. / Internet Archive (historyofassam00gait)
description: The landmark first edition of Sir Edward Gait's definitive history of Assam. Based on direct translations of original Ahom Buranjis, Assamese manuscripts, and Persian chronicles examined under the direction of Gait and Pandit Golap Chandra Barua. Contains the primary historical accounts of Chao Lung Sukapha's 1215-1228 A.D. migration from Mong Mao, crossing the Patkai range into Nora/Khamjang territory, establishing settlements at Khamhangpung and Namrup, bridging the Sessa, and founding the capital at Charaideo.
